spec: Write lru.py with class `LRUCache(capacity: int)` having `get(key, default=None)` and `put(key, value)`, both O(1), evicting the least recently used entry when full. `get` and `put` of an existing key both mark it as most recently used. Implement `__len__` and `__contains__` (membership test must NOT change recency). capacity < 1 raises ValueError. Standard library only (collections.OrderedDict is allowed).
